title: Your account
description: Your sign-in details, language and the devices you are signed in on.

errors.freshAuthRequired: For this action you need to confirm again that it is you.
errors.useRecoveryCode: Your account has no email. Confirm with a recovery code.
errors.noRecoveryCodes: This account does not use recovery codes.
errors.emailUnavailable: We cannot use this address. Choose another one.
errors.noEmail: This account has no email address.

fresh.title: Confirm it is you
fresh.emailBody: This is a sensitive action. We will email you a new code; the confirmation lasts 10 minutes.
fresh.recoveryBody: This is a sensitive action. Your account has no email, so you confirm it with one of your recovery codes. The code you use cannot be used again.
fresh.sentBody: We have sent a six-digit code to the address of this account. It is valid for 15 minutes.

profile.title: Profile
profile.anonymousNote: This account has no email: you get no email digests, and notifications appear only inside the app.
profile.languageHint: Changes the wording of the app only, never your data.
profile.displayNameHint: This is how the people you plan with see you: on the team and on tasks. If you leave it empty, your email address or username is shown.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.body: These are the devices your account is open on right now.
sessions.everywhereNote: The button below signs the account out on every device, this one included, and revokes all keys for external assistants.

security.title: Sign-in and safety
security.deleteMeta: With 7 days to change your mind

twoStep.title: Two-step sign-in
twoStep.description: Optional. When it is on, after the emailed code (or password) we also ask for a code from an authenticator app of your choice.
twoStep.offBody: It works with any standard authenticator app (six-digit codes that change every 30 seconds).
twoStep.onBody: Every time you sign in we also ask for the code from your authenticator app.
twoStep.scanTitle: Scan the code with the app
twoStep.scanBody: Open your authenticator app, add a new account and scan the image. Then type the code the app shows below.
twoStep.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app. If you cannot scan it, use the key written below.
twoStep.codesBody: Use one instead of the code from the app if you do not have your phone at hand.
twoStep.codesBodyAnonymous: They are the only way to recover the account if you forget the password, and you use them to confirm sensitive actions.
twoStep.regenerateWarning: If you generate new codes, the old ones stop working.

email.title: Sign-in email
email.currentNone: Your account is anonymous: it has no email address.
email.addBody: The account becomes an email account: you will sign in with an emailed code, and the password and username are no longer used to sign in.
email.changeBody: We send a code to the new address to make sure it is yours.
email.signOutNote: After the change the account is signed out on every other device and all keys for external assistants are revoked. You stay signed in on this device.
email.sendCode: Send the code to the new address
email.codeSentBody: We have sent a six-digit code to {email}. It is valid for 15 minutes.
email.changedBody: From now on you sign in with {email}. Your other devices were signed out.
email.removeMeansNoEmail: There is no email sign-in and there are no email digests any more; notifications appear only inside the app.
email.removeMeansPassword: You will sign in with a username and the password you choose now.
email.removeMeansCodes: You get ten new recovery codes. Without the password and the codes the account cannot be recovered.
email.removedBody: Your account is anonymous again. Write down the username and save the codes below.
email.savedBack: I have saved the codes — back to account

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: You have {days} days to change your mind. After that the deletion is final.
delete.happensUndo: For {days} days the account stays as it is and you can undo the deletion at any time from the “Account” page.
delete.happensGone: After that we delete the sign-in details, the sessions and the personal data of the account. We cannot get them back.
delete.happensTokens: All keys for external assistants are deleted together with the account.
delete.retainedIntro: The law requires us to keep a few records even after deletion:
delete.retainedReceipts: Receipts and invoices — {years} years, for tax and accounting obligations.
delete.retainedObjections: Records of objections and personal-data requests — {years} years, so we can show that we honoured them.
delete.retainedAudit: The audit log of actions — {years} years, for safety and for settling disputes.
delete.pendingTitle: The account is scheduled for deletion
delete.pendingBody: You can undo the deletion until {date}. After that the account is deleted for good.
